I wrote `component.html` in the folder, with the whole screen inside `<div id="component">` at 1280px wide. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

I read every file in the folder. `session.json` is empty, and `session.err` only logs an unrecognized-model message. `DESIGN.md` and `tokens.css` drove the build:
- **Tokens:** I copied only the light-theme tokens the page uses into an inline `:root`, since the file has to be self-contained. Styles use `var(--…)` only, with no raw hex outside that block.
- **Page and cards:** The page is white, one centered column of 1120px, with 48px above it and 32px side padding. The title is Unbounded Light in caps at `--text-heading`, and the three sections are cards 32px apart.
- **Form fields:** Both fields are 44px tall, with labels in the spaced-caps label style 8px above them. The focus ring is 2px `--accent`.
- **Buttons:** "Save Changes" is the one Primary button (ink fill). "Delete Workspace" is Secondary with no red, as the rules require.
- **Switches:** They are CSS-only checkboxes with `role="switch"`, in 52px rows, and motion stops under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

I made two choices you didn't specify:
- **Switch defaults:** I set "Email me when a request is assigned to me" and "Weekly summary" to on, and "Product updates" to off.
- **Save Changes placement:** I kept it in the General section, as your content said. `DESIGN.md` says the top row should hold the screen's primary action on the right, so the top row has only the title.

No font files are included, so Unbounded and Archivo fall back to system fonts unless they're installed.
